# StudySmarter

> StudySmarter is the #1 intelligent learning app combining flashcards, spaced repetition, and AI-powered exam prep across university and school curricula.

StudySmarter provides free verified study materials, explanations, and interactive learning tools across sciences, languages, humanities, and professional subjects. The platform leverages spaced repetition and AI learning to help students master content for GCSE, A-Level, AP, and degree-level exams.

## Key Topics

- Spaced Repetition
- Flashcards
- Exam AI
- Study Planning
- GCSE
- A-Level
- AP Exams

## Core Learning Platform

- [StudySmarter | The #1 learning app for university & school](https://www.studysmarter.co.uk): StudySmarter homepage: intelligent learning app with flashcards, spaced repetition, and exam prep
- [Explanations, Flashcards, Quizzes, and More - Free and Verified](https://www.studysmarter.co.uk/explanations): StudySmarter Originals: directory of free study materials across academic subjects

## Science & Mathematics

- [Biology: Revision Notes for A-level, GCSE, AP and More](https://www.studysmarter.co.uk/explanations/biology): Biology revision notes for A-level, GCSE, and AP with flashcards and study planner
- [Chemistry: Topics, Notes, Formula & Study Guide | StudySmarter](https://www.studysmarter.co.uk/explanations/chemistry): Chemistry study guide covering organic, physical, inorganic topics, equations, and formulas
- [Combined Science: GCSE, Revision, Synergy, Trilogy & Flashcards](https://www.studysmarter.co.uk/explanations/combined-science): GCSE Combined Science guide for physics, biology, chemistry with flashcards
- [Engineering: Types, Mechanics, Civil & Design | StudySmarter](https://www.studysmarter.co.uk/explanations/engineering): Engineering guide covering mechanics, civil engineering, design, and thermodynamics
- [Environmental Science: Topics, Notes, Examples & Study Guide](https://www.studysmarter.co.uk/explanations/environmental-science): Environmental Science study guide covering living world, climate change, and Earth

## Languages & Literature

- [English Literature: Topics, Notes, Examples & Study Guide](https://www.studysmarter.co.uk/explanations/english-literature): English Literature guide covering novels, poetry, drama, fiction, and Shakespeare
- [English Language: Topics, Notes, Examples & Study Guide](https://www.studysmarter.co.uk/explanations/english): English Language study guide covering grammar, writing, reading, and speaking skills
- [French: Grammar, Phrases & French Culture | StudySmarter](https://www.studysmarter.co.uk/explanations/french): French language learning with grammar, phrases, cultural education, and flashcards
- [Chinese Languages: Grammar & Social Issues | StudySmarter](https://www.studysmarter.co.uk/explanations/chinese): Chinese language learning with grammar, social issues, and flashcard explanations
- [Bengali: Grammar, Phrases & Bengali Culture | StudySmarter](https://www.studysmarter.co.uk/explanations/bengali): Bengali language learning guide with grammar, phrases, and cultural education

## Social Sciences & Business

- [Business Studies: Revision Notes & Exam Prep | StudySmarter](https://www.studysmarter.co.uk/explanations/business-studies): Business Studies revision notes with exam prep, flashcards, and study planning tools
